title: Book One · Chapter 162: Not One More Thing
story:
On Monday, Miss Wu asks for their reading books. Ronan reaches into his bag. He finds the room plan first. The game list and stool copy are underneath. Three loose cards are there too. His reading book is at home beside the bed.

He closes his eyes for a moment. He finished the reading. He has nothing to show Miss Wu.

“I left it at home,” he says.

She gives him a plain sheet for the lesson. He must bring the book tomorrow. He must still do his reading work. The display does not replace his normal lessons.

At break Ronan empties his bag onto the desk. He expected a few papers. There are a lot. Two cards are old copies. One list has been replaced by a newer one. He is afraid of losing something. So he has kept even the old copies in his bag. Now there is too much paper to find his books.

Mei gets a paper cover and gives it to him. This one is for schoolwork. She has one for drawings and one for lessons. Her bag is not always neat, she says. But lessons go in one cover and drawings in the other. She can find things faster that way.

Ronan laughs and begins sorting. He does not throw everything away. The old copies go into one folder at home. He keeps the newest display list. That one stays in a thin cover. There is space for the reading book again.

Leo comes with another idea. A child in their class has a song ready. She wants to sing at River Street Day. “Can you make time for my song?” she asks.

Ronan almost says yes because she is already prepared. Then he looks at the room plan. They planned a quiet room for looking at pictures. There is no place for a crowd to watch singing. Miss Wu has only agreed to the small display.

“We must ask Miss Wu,” he says.

The teacher listens. There may be time for the song another day. It could be part of a class lesson. She cannot add a performance to this afternoon. The child is disappointed. She cannot sing at the display. But she still wants to visit the pictures.

Ronan walks home with Leo. He said no to the song. He feels bad now. The girl wanted to sing it for them.

“It was a good song,” he says.

“It still is,” Leo says. “People can enjoy it another day. We can hear it another day.”

At home Ronan puts his reading book in the school cover first. He gives the old papers to Mum. She can check them before he puts them away. Mum finds a cost note on one old paper. They still need that note. He keeps it with the current list.

The rest of the evening is ordinary schoolwork. He reads and writes two lines. Then he does his sums. He gets one wrong and tries it again. Mum finishes her paid repairs beside him. Dad eats late. “Who won the ball game?” he asks.

At first, Ronan cannot remember the ball game. He keeps thinking about the display. “Mei's side won,” he tells Dad. He remembers a good run in the game. Then he thinks of Leo's wet shoe. That happened on an earlier day. Soon they are laughing about the shoe again.

Before bed he checks the bag once. The reading book is there. So is the thin display cover. There is room between them for his lunch cloth. He shuts the bag and leaves it shut. Tomorrow he can find his reading book easily. The old display papers are safe at home. He can leave them there.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：replace＝替代、代替；folder＝文件夹；performance＝表演。

情节提示：replaced＝替换了；cost note＝费用记录；disappointed＝失望的。

理解：1. Ronan 怎样让书包更好整理？2. 为什么准备好的歌曲也不能直接加入？
